field.label: Enable
field.help: Answer the Wi-Fi access points and proxy their EAP-TTLS requests to the central RADIUS servers.

field.label: Listen interfaces
field.help: The service listens on the static IPv4 address of each selected interface, on port 1812, and nowhere else. An interface with a gateway, a dynamic address or the WAN cannot be chosen.

field.label: Server certificate
field.help: The certificate the access points' clients see, from System > Trust > Certificates. Its private key must be stored on this firewall.

field.label: Certificate authority
field.help: The authority that issued the server certificate. It and its parents are sent along with the server certificate.

field.label: Access point networks
field.help: IPv4 networks or addresses the access points send requests from, for example 192.0.2.0/24.

field.label: Access point secret
field.help: The RADIUS shared secret configured on the access points. It is never shown again; leave the field empty to keep the stored one.

field.label: Log logins
field.help: Write one line per login to the log, "Login OK", "Login incorrect", or "Login failed" when no central server answers, with the user name, the access point (client) and the calling station. Passwords are never logged, correct or not. The log is under Services: Kazuha Hub Wi-Fi RADIUS: Log File.

field.label: Sync certificates from the central node
field.help: Every 6 hours, fetch the server certificate, its key and the authority from the central node, and use them when they changed and pass every check: the sums match, the certificate chains to the authority, is valid now, carries the expected name and matches the key. The service is then restarted. On any failure the current set stays in use. The certificate selected above is used until a central set has been accepted, and whenever none is valid. Only outbound requests are made; nothing new listens.

field.label: Certificate sources
field.help: The central nodes that serve the set over plain HTTP on a private network, as http://address:port, separated by commas, in fail-over order (at most 8). Each sync asks them in turn and takes the whole set from the first one that answers for SHA256SUMS; files from two sources are never mixed. If none answers, the current set stays in use and one log line names each source and why it failed. While the list is empty, nothing is pulled.

field.label: Expected certificate name
field.help: The DNS name the central server certificate must carry in its subjectAltName. While it is empty, nothing is pulled.

field.label: Certificate source user
field.help: The account of this site on the central node, sent with HTTP Basic authentication. While the user or the password is empty, no pull is made and the sync logs that.

field.label: Certificate source password
field.help: It is never shown again; leave the field empty to keep the stored one.
